Results.ReviewText:
First of all, we purchased this grill well over a year ago in May (2019).  It was fine for awhile, but then earlier this year (June 2020) the ignition system stopped working so the right burner does not ignite -- we have to manually light with a match.  It's very annoying but we manage.   I've been in touch with your company and they are "supposedly" sending us a new ignition kit as of 2 months ago, we haven't received as yet!!  We did receive the "free consolation gift" of a grill scraper, which we didn't need.  We really could use the ignition kit to make the grill work correctly.   I'm very disappointed in this product, although we've had many Weber models before -- not sure we would buy a Weber again based on our experience with this product!  Seems the quality has gone downhill...
Also, I don't think the design of having "only 2 wheels instead of 4" is a very good idea.  Moving the grill is more difficult with only 2.   Thanks for asking me, otherwise don't think I would've gone to the trouble to initiate this review, but now I feel better.  

Steve Dragonuk

Results.ReviewText: I struggled with purchasing a Weber because of the price. I bought my first Weber, the Spirit II E-210, which is the one I am reviewing, and was blown away at how great it cooked. This grill will put grill marks on the meat you are cooking like no other grill can. Heat very controllable. High end thermometer and solid construction. The only issue I have with this grill is, instead of having a separate ignitor for both burners, it has a small tube that connects from the one burner to the other with only one ignitor. It uses the tube to carry the flame to the 2nd burner. The issue is the connecting tube clogs with rust very easily. They should replace the tube with a 2nd ignitor. With that said, I now own 3 Weber grills. Also, I scored this grill a 4 out of 5, but I give Weber's customer service a 5 out of 5. Everyone I talked to were very personable and helpful. When the tube mentioned above clogged, I called Weber and they replaced it for me. Great grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, thank you for taking the time to submit your feedback! We are sorry to hear about the trouble you are having with this! Next time you use your grill, we suggest the following to help with heating issues. 
1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position.
3. Fully disconnect your tank from the rubber hose and reconnect it.
4. Open your LP tank slowly, fully open.
5. Wait 1 full minute
6. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
7. Hit your igniter
8. Turn on all remaining burners
9. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F. If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team as they are happy to help. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: We bought the Spirit E-210 grill because we wanted to downsize a bit from our large grill and because Weber has a very good reputation.  So far we like everything about it.  Though it's a two burner grill there is plenty of room for our needs (2 people). There is room for a lot more food if we have guests.  I love the grates.  They have wide slates on one side and if you flip them over they are narrow.  I've used the wide slats for salmon and it works beautifully.  I put a very small amount of olive oil on the under side of the salmon and they come off the grill without sticking or leaving pieces stuck to the grill.  I've also grilled chicken with the same results.  We like the meter attached to the gas tank that shows how much fuel is left.  The ignition button works easily.  We bought a Weber cover made for this model and it fits nicely with lots of protection.  We had the grill delivered already assembled from Ace Hardware so I can't comment on ease of setting it up.  So far we are very pleased with this purchase.
Results.Title: The ideal grill for us.

Results.ReviewText:
After unpacking the grill I Incountered some problems. The frame was badly bent. A return to Lowes resolved that problem. When assembly was completed I attached the lpg tank and there was a very bad leak at the regulator. I contacted customer service and after some questions and pictures of my tank they agreed to send a new regulator and gas line, but the said it would be 10 days. I complained and they said it would be overnighted. After a week it was still not shipped and I was told it was out of stock and would be a few more weeks. I wrote a bad review and was then told that the part would be shipped that day. I went to Lowes and got the part off the shelf (should have been my first reaction). The replacement part arrived a few days later. 
So after a bad start I think the grill is nice although  I question if it worth the additional dollars. Initial quality was lacking. Only time will tell if it is worth the price.
Results.Title: Initial quality

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
